We propose an emotion-context-aware VR interaction pipeline that treats vocal emotion as explicit dialogue context in an LLM-based conversational agent. A real-time speech emotion recognition model infers users' emotional states from prosody, and the resulting emotion labels are injected into the agent's dialogue context to shape response tone and style. Results from a within-subjects VR study (N=30) show significant improvements in dialogue quality, naturalness, engagement, rapport, and human-likeness, with 93.3% of participants preferring the emotion-aware agent.
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, Accepted to CHI EA 2026 (Extended Abstracts of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems)

title: OddGridBench: Exposing the Lack of Fine-Grained Visual Discrepancy Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of vision language tasks. However, their ability in low-level visual perception, particularly in detecting fine-grained visual discrepancies, remains underexplored and lacks systematic analysis. In this work, we introduce OddGridBench, a controllable benchmark for evaluating the visual discrepancy sensitivity of MLLMs. OddGridBench comprises over 1,400 grid-based images, where a single element differs from all others by one or multiple visual attributes such as color, size, rotation, or position. Experiments reveal that all evaluated MLLMs, including open-source families such as Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5, and proprietary systems like Gemini-2.5-Pro and GPT-5, perform far below human levels in visual discrepancy detection. We further propose OddGrid-GRPO, a reinforcement learning framework that integrates curriculum learning and distance-aware reward. By progressively controlling the difficulty of training samples and incorporating spatial proximity constraints into the reward design, OddGrid-GRPO significantly enhances the model's fine-grained visual discrimination ability. We hope OddGridBench and OddGrid-GRPO will lay the groundwork for advancing perceptual grounding and visual discrepancy sensitivity in multimodal intelligence. Code and dataset are available at https://wwwtttjjj.github.io/OddGridBench/.

title: Measuring onion website discovery and Tor users' interests with honeypots
summary: Tor enables anonymous web browsing and access to anonymous onion websites. Prior work has focused on crawling and content analysis rather than on what users actually try to access. Our honeypot approach measures engagement across onion-site categories, revealing behavioral interest rather than inferred popularity. In March--April 2025, we deployed honeypot onion websites and seeded neutral-looking links via three channels -- the Ahmia Tor search engine, Stronghold paste onion "paste" service, and pastebin.com -- to observe discovery and subsequent interaction events (CAPTCHA solves; registration/login attempts). We observe that, almost without exception, human users originate from Ahmia.fi; after removing the honeypot links from the Ahmia.fi search results, visits dropped to nearly zero and no users solved CAPTCHAs. The honeypot landing front pages represent different forums for cybercrime activities -- child sexual abuse, violence, malware, stolen goods, illegal firearms, illegal drugs, and forgery items -- and, as a baseline comparison, an unclear forum. Within that set, the CSAM-themed honeypot drew markedly higher engagement than the other honeypots. When identical sites were offered in multiple languages, interaction events occurred most often on the English-language versions.

title: Reward-Zero: Language Embedding Driven Implicit Reward Mechanisms for Reinforcement Learning
summary: We introduce Reward-Zero, a general-purpose implicit reward mechanism that transforms natural-language task descriptions into dense, semantically grounded progress signals for reinforcement learning (RL). Reward-Zero serves as a simple yet sophisticated universal reward function that leverages language embeddings for efficient RL training. By comparing the embedding of a task specification with embeddings derived from an agent's interaction experience, Reward-Zero produces a continuous, semantically aligned sense-of-completion signal. This reward supplements sparse or delayed environmental feedback without requiring task-specific engineering. When integrated into standard RL frameworks, it accelerates exploration, stabilizes training, and enhances generalization across diverse tasks. Empirically, agents trained with Reward-Zero converge faster and achieve higher final success rates than conventional methods such as PPO with common reward-shaping baselines, successfully solving tasks that hand-designed rewards could not in some complex tasks. In addition, we develop a mini benchmark for the evaluation of completion sense during task execution via language embeddings. These results highlight the promise of language-driven implicit reward functions as a practical path toward more sample-efficient, generalizable, and scalable RL for embodied agents. Code will be released after peer review.

title: TimberAgent: Gram-Guided Retrieval for Executable Music Effect Control
summary: Digital audio workstations expose rich effect chains, yet a semantic gap remains between perceptual user intent and low-level signal-processing parameters. We study retrieval-grounded audio effect control, where the output is an editable plugin configuration rather than a finalized waveform. Our focus is Texture Resonance Retrieval (TRR), an audio representation built from Gram matrices of projected mid-level Wav2Vec2 activations. This design preserves texture-relevant co-activation structure. We evaluate TRR on a guitar-effects benchmark with 1,063 candidate presets and 204 queries. The evaluation follows Protocol-A, a cross-validation scheme that prevents train-test leakage. We compare TRR against CLAP and internal retrieval baselines (Wav2Vec-RAG, Text-RAG, FeatureNN-RAG), using min-max normalized metrics grounded in physical DSP parameter ranges. Ablation studies validate TRR's core design choices: projection dimensionality, layer selection, and projection type. A near-duplicate sensitivity analysis confirms that results are robust to trivial knowledge-base matches. TRR achieves the lowest normalized parameter error among evaluated methods. A multiple-stimulus listening study with 26 participants provides complementary perceptual evidence. We interpret these results as benchmark evidence that texture-aware retrieval is useful for editable audio effect control, while broader personalization and real-audio robustness claims remain outside the verified evidence presented here.

title: Dynamic Precision Math Engine for Linear Algebra and Trigonometry Acceleration on Xtensa LX6 Microcontrollers
comments: 22 pages, 2 figures, experimental evaluation on ESP32-WROOM-32 hardware
summary: Low-cost embedded processors such as the ESP32 (Xtensa LX6, 32-bit dual-core, 240 MHz) are increasingly used in edge computing applications that require real-time physical simulation, sensor fusion, and control systems. Although the ESP32 integrates a single-precision IEEE 754 floating-point unit, floating-point operations introduce pipeline overhead and higher energy consumption compared to integer arithmetic, limiting throughput for floating-point intensive workloads. This paper presents the design, formal specification, and empirical evaluation of a Dynamic Precision Math Engine for the ESP32. The system integrates three main components: a Q16.16 fixed-point arithmetic core that maps mathematical operations onto the integer pipeline of the Xtensa LX6, a 16-iteration CORDIC trigonometric module that computes sine and cosine using only additions and bit shifts, and a cache-aware tiled matrix multiplication kernel with deferred correction to reduce rounding operations. The architecture introduces a runtime precision switching mechanism implemented through function pointer dispatch and a synchronization protocol compatible with FreeRTOS. This mechanism allows applications to dynamically transition between a fast fixed-point execution path and a precise IEEE 754 floating-point path without recompilation. Experimental evaluation on ESP32-WROOM-32 hardware using 300 paired measurements shows that the CORDIC trigonometric module achieves median latencies of 293 cycles for both sine and cosine, corresponding to mean speedups of 18.5x and 24.7x compared to the standard math library. The results demonstrate that precision-aware software architecture can significantly improve numerical performance on low-cost microcontrollers.
comment: 22 pages, 2 figures, experimental evaluation on ESP32-WROOM-32 hardware

title: Can ChatGPT Generate Realistic Synthetic System Requirement Specifications? Results of a Case Study
comments: This is the accepted version of a paper that will appear in the proceedings of the 21st International Conference on Evaluation of Novel Approaches of Software Engineering (ENASE 2026). The final published version will be available from Science and Technology Publications (SCITEPRESS). 15 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables
summary: System requirement specifications (SyRSs) are central, natural-language (NL) artifacts. Access to real SyRS for research purposes is highly valuable but limited by proprietary restrictions or confidentiality concerns. Generating synthetic SyRSs (SSyRSs) can address this scarcity. Black-box large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT offer compelling generation capabilities by providing easy access to NL generation functions without requiring access to real data. However, LLMs suffer from hallucinations and overconfidence, which pose major challenges in their use. We designed an exploratory study to investigate whether, despite these challenges, we can generate realistic SSyRSs with ChatGPT without having access to real SyRSs. Using a systematic approach that leverages prompt patterns, LLM-based quality assessments, and iterative prompt refinements, we generated 300 SSyRSs across 10 industries with ChatGPT. The results were evaluated using cross-model checks and an expert study, with n=87 submitted surveys. 62\% of experts considered the SSyRSs to be realistic. However, in-depth examination revealed contradictory statements and deficiencies. Overall, we were able to generate realistic SSyRSs to a certain extent with ChatGPT, but LLM-based quality assessments cannot fully replace thorough expert evaluations. This paper presents the methodology and results of our study and discusses the key insights we obtained.
comment: This is the accepted version of a paper that will appear in the proceedings of the 21st International Conference on Evaluation of Novel Approaches of Software Engineering (ENASE 2026). The final published version will be available from Science and Technology Publications (SCITEPRESS). 15 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables

AI.title_translation: ChatGPT能否生成真实的合成系统需求规格？一项案例研究的结果
AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了ChatGPT在没有真实系统需求规格数据的情况下，生成真实合成系统需求规格的能力。结果显示，虽然ChatGPT能在一定程度上生成逼真的规格，但LLM的质量评估不能完全取代专家评估。
AI.motivation: 由于专有和保密限制，研究人员难以获取真实的系统需求规格（SyRSs）。生成合成系统需求规格（SSyRSs）可以解决这种稀缺性。
AI.method: 研究设计了一项探索性研究，利用提示模式、基于LLM的质量评估和迭代提示优化，使用ChatGPT生成了来自10个行业的300个SSyRS。通过跨模型检查和专家研究（n=87份提交的调查），对结果进行了评估。
AI.result: 62%的专家认为SSyRSs是真实的。然而，深入检查发现了矛盾的陈述和缺陷。总体而言，ChatGPT在一定程度上能够生成真实的SSyRSs。
AI.conclusion: ChatGPT在一定程度上能够生成真实的合成系统需求规格，但基于LLM的质量评估不能完全取代彻底的专家评估。
AI.translation: 系统需求规格（SyRSs）是核心的自然语言（NL）文本。出于研究目的获取真实的SyRSs非常有价值，但受到专有限制或保密问题的限制。生成合成SyRSs（SSyRSs）可以解决这种稀缺性。像ChatGPT这样的黑盒大型语言模型（LLMs）通过提供易于访问的自然语言生成功能，而无需访问真实数据，提供了引人注目的生成能力。然而，LLMs存在幻觉和过度自信的问题，这对其使用构成了重大挑战。我们设计了一项探索性研究，以调查尽管存在这些挑战，我们是否能够在不访问真实SyRSs的情况下，使用ChatGPT生成真实的SSyRSs。我们采用了一种系统方法，利用提示模式、基于LLM的质量评估和迭代提示细化，使用ChatGPT生成了来自10个行业的300个SSyRSs。结果通过跨模型检查和专家研究进行评估，共提交了87份调查。62%的专家认为SSyRSs是真实的。然而，深入检查发现了矛盾的陈述和缺陷。总体而言，我们能够在一定程度上使用ChatGPT生成真实的SSyRSs，但基于LLM的质量评估不能完全取代彻底的专家评估。本文介绍了我们研究的方法和结果，并讨论了我们获得的关键见解。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了ChatGPT在无法访问真实系统需求规格（SyRSs）的情况下，生成真实合成系统需求规格（SSyRSs）的能力。通过系统性方法，包括提示模式和LLM质量评估，研究生成了300个SSyRSs并由专家评估。结果显示，62%的专家认为SSyRSs是真实的，但仍存在缺陷。研究得出结论，ChatGPT能在一定程度上生成逼真的SSyRSs，但LLM的质量评估无法完全替代专家评估。
AI.keywords: ChatGPT, 合成系统需求规格, 大型语言模型, 专家评估, 提示工程
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于探索了大型语言模型（如ChatGPT）在生成系统需求规格这一特定领域的能力，为解决真实数据稀缺问题提供了潜在方案。其重要性在于为软件工程研究和实践提供了获取合成数据的途径。然而，研究也明确指出了LLM在生成内容中的局限性，即可能存在矛盾和缺陷，并强调了专家人工评估的不可替代性，这对未来LLM在关键领域应用提出了警示。

title: Beyond Scaling: Assessing Strategic Reasoning and Rapid Decision-Making Capability of LLMs in Zero-sum Environments
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance on static reasoning benchmarks, yet their effectiveness as interactive agents operating in adversarial, time-sensitive environments remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations largely treat reasoning as a single-shot capability, overlooking the challenges of opponent-aware decision-making, temporal constraints, and execution under pressure. This paper introduces Strategic Tactical Agent Reasoning (STAR) Benchmark, a multi-agent evaluation framework that assesses LLMs through 1v1 zero-sum competitive interactions, framing reasoning as an iterative, adaptive decision-making process. STAR supports both turn-based and real-time settings, enabling controlled analysis of long-horizon strategic planning and fast-paced tactical execution within a unified environment. Built on a modular architecture with a standardized API and fully implemented execution engine, STAR facilitates reproducible evaluation and flexible task customization. To move beyond binary win-loss outcomes, we introduce a Strategic Evaluation Suite that assesses not only competitive success but also the quality of strategic behavior, such as execution efficiency and outcome stability. Extensive pairwise evaluations reveal a pronounced strategy-execution gap: while reasoning-intensive models dominate turn-based settings, their inference latency often leads to inferior performance in real-time scenarios, where faster instruction-tuned models prevail. These results show that strategic intelligence in interactive environments depends not only on reasoning depth, but also on the ability to translate plans into timely actions, positioning STAR as a principled benchmark for studying this trade-off in competitive, dynamic settings.

AI.title_translation: 超越规模：评估大型语言模型在零和环境中的战略推理和快速决策能力
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了STAR基准测试，一个多智能体评估框架，用于通过1对1零和竞争互动来评估LLM在对抗性、时间敏感环境中的战略推理和快速决策能力。研究发现，推理密集型模型在回合制设置中表现出色，但在实时场景中，由于推理延迟，其性能不如指令微调模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的大型语言模型（LLMs）评估主要将推理视为一次性能力，忽视了对手感知决策、时间限制和压力下执行的挑战，未能充分理解LLMs作为互动智能体在对抗性、时间敏感环境中的有效性。
AI.method: 本文引入了战略战术智能体推理（STAR）基准测试，这是一个多智能体评估框架，通过1对1零和竞争互动来评估LLMs，将推理视为一个迭代、适应性决策过程。STAR支持回合制和实时设置，并具有模块化架构、标准化API和完整的执行引擎。此外，还引入了战略评估套件，不仅评估竞争成功，还评估战略行为的质量，如执行效率和结果稳定性。
AI.result: 广泛的配对评估揭示了显著的策略-执行差距：推理密集型模型在回合制设置中占据主导地位，但其推理延迟常常导致在实时场景中表现不佳，而在此类场景中，更快的指令微调模型则占据优势。
AI.conclusion: 交互式环境中的战略智能不仅取决于推理深度，还取决于将计划转化为及时行动的能力。STAR基准测试为研究竞争性动态环境中的这种权衡提供了一个原则性的方法。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在静态推理基准测试中取得了强大的性能，但它们作为在对抗性、时间敏感环境中运行的交互式智能体的有效性仍然知之甚少。现有的评估主要将推理视为一次性能力，忽视了对手感知决策、时间限制和压力下执行的挑战。本文引入了战略战术智能体推理（STAR）基准测试，这是一个多智能体评估框架，通过1对1零和竞争互动来评估LLMs，将推理框定为一个迭代、适应性决策过程。STAR支持回合制和实时设置，从而能够在统一环境中对长远战略规划和快速战术执行进行受控分析。STAR建立在模块化架构上，具有标准化的API和完全实现的执行引擎，有助于可重现的评估和灵活的任务定制。为了超越二元的输赢结果，我们引入了一个战略评估套件，不仅评估竞争成功，还评估战略行为的质量，例如执行效率和结果稳定性。广泛的配对评估揭示了显著的策略-执行差距：推理密集型模型在回合制设置中占据主导地位，但其推理延迟常常导致在实时场景中表现不佳，而在此类场景中，更快的指令微调模型则占据优势。这些结果表明，交互式环境中的战略智能不仅取决于推理深度，还取决于将计划转化为及时行动的能力，这使得STAR成为研究竞争性动态环境中这种权衡的原则性基准。
AI.summary: 本文提出了战略战术智能体推理（STAR）基准测试，这是一个多智能体评估框架，旨在评估大型语言模型（LLMs）在对抗性、时间敏感的零和环境中的战略推理和快速决策能力。STAR通过1对1竞争互动，支持回合制和实时设置，并引入战略评估套件来衡量策略质量。研究发现，推理深度与执行速度之间存在权衡，推理密集型模型在回合制中表现优异，但在实时场景中，由于延迟，其性能不如指令微调模型。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 战略推理, 快速决策, 零和博弈, STAR基准测试
AI.comments: 本文通过引入STAR基准测试，创新性地将LLM的评估从静态推理扩展到动态、交互式和时间敏感的零和竞争环境。其亮点在于同时考虑了战略规划和战术执行，并揭示了LLM在推理深度和行动速度之间的策略-执行差距，这对于理解LLM在真实世界复杂场景中的应用潜力及局限性具有重要意义。该框架的模块化设计和战略评估套件也提高了评估的全面性和可复现性。

title: Predictive Spectral Calibration for Source-Free Test-Time Regression
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) for image regression has received far less attention than its classification counterpart. Methods designed for classification often depend on classification-specific objectives and decision boundaries, making them difficult to transfer directly to continuous regression targets. Recent progress revisits regression TTA through subspace alignment, showing that simple source-guided alignment can be both practical and effective. Building on this line of work, we propose Predictive Spectral Calibration (PSC), a source-free framework that extends subspace alignment to block spectral matching. Instead of relying on a fixed support subspace alone, PSC jointly aligns target features within the source predictive support and calibrates residual spectral slack in the orthogonal complement. PSC remains simple to implement, model-agnostic, and compatible with off-the-shelf pretrained regressors. Experiments on multiple image regression benchmarks show consistent improvements over strong baselines, with particularly clear gains under severe distribution shifts.

AI.title_translation: 源免测试时间回归的预测谱校准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了预测谱校准 (PSC)，一个源免测试时间回归框架，通过块谱匹配扩展了子空间对齐，并在严重分布偏移下表现出显著改进。
AI.motivation: 图像回归的测试时间适应 (TTA) 受到的关注远少于分类任务，且为分类设计的方法难以直接应用于连续回归目标。虽然现有的回归 TTA 方法通过子空间对齐取得了一定进展，但仍有改进空间，尤其是在源免（source-free）设置下。
AI.method: 本文提出了预测谱校准 (PSC)，一个源免框架，它将子空间对齐扩展到块谱匹配。PSC 在源预测支持子空间内联合对齐目标特征，并在正交补空间中校准残余谱松弛。PSC 的设计使其易于实现、与模型无关，并兼容现成的预训练回归器。
AI.result: 在多个图像回归基准测试中，PSC 始终优于强大的基线方法，尤其在严重分布偏移下表现出特别明显的提升。
AI.conclusion: 预测谱校准 (PSC) 为源免测试时间回归提供了一种有效且实用的解决方案，通过扩展子空间对齐和校准谱松弛，显著提高了模型在面对严重分布偏移时的性能。
AI.translation: 图像回归的测试时间适应 (TTA) 受到的关注远少于其分类对应物。为分类设计的方法通常依赖于分类特定的目标和决策边界，这使得它们难以直接转移到连续回归目标。最近的进展通过子空间对齐重新审视了回归 TTA，表明简单的源引导对齐既实用又有效。基于这一系列工作，我们提出了预测谱校准 (PSC)，这是一个源免框架，将子空间对齐扩展到块谱匹配。PSC 不仅依赖于固定的支持子空间，还在源预测支持子空间内联合对齐目标特征，并在正交补空间中校准残余谱松弛。PSC 易于实现，与模型无关，并与现成的预训练回归器兼容。在多个图像回归基准测试上的实验表明，与强大的基线相比，PSC 持续改进，在严重分布偏移下尤其表现出明显的收益。
AI.summary: 本文提出了预测谱校准 (PSC)，一个针对图像回归的源免测试时间适应 (TTA) 框架。该方法通过将子空间对齐扩展到块谱匹配，并在源预测支持子空间内对齐目标特征并校准正交补空间中的残余谱松弛，解决了回归TTA的挑战。PSC易于实现、与模型无关，并兼容现有预训练回归器。实验结果表明，PSC 在多个图像回归基准测试中，尤其是在严重分布偏移下，均优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 测试时间适应, 图像回归, 源免, 子空间对齐, 谱校准
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入预测谱校准 (PSC) 框架，为源免测试时间回归提供了一个新颖且实用的解决方案。其创新点在于将子空间对齐扩展到块谱匹配，并在正交补空间中进行谱松弛校准，有效解决了回归TTA在缺乏源数据和存在严重分布偏移时的挑战。PSC的简单性、模型无关性以及与现有回归器的兼容性是其重要优势，预示着该方法在实际应用中具有广阔前景。

title: TaSR-RAG: Taxonomy-guided Structured Reasoning for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) helps large language models (LLMs) answer knowledge-intensive and time-sensitive questions by conditioning generation on external evidence. However, most RAG systems still retrieve unstructured chunks and rely on one-shot generation, which often yields redundant context, low information density, and brittle multi-hop reasoning. While structured RAG pipelines can improve grounding, they typically require costly and error-prone graph construction or impose rigid entity-centric structures that do not align with the query's reasoning chain.
  We propose \textsc{TaSR-RAG}, a taxonomy-guided structured reasoning framework for evidence selection. We represent both queries and documents as relational triples, and constrain entity semantics with a lightweight two-level taxonomy to balance generalization and precision. Given a complex question, \textsc{TaSR-RAG} decomposes it into an ordered sequence of triple sub-queries with explicit latent variables, then performs step-wise evidence selection via hybrid triple matching that combines semantic similarity over raw triples with structural consistency over typed triples.
  By maintaining an explicit entity binding table across steps, \textsc{TaSR-RAG} resolves intermediate variables and reduces entity conflation without explicit graph construction or exhaustive search. Experiments on multiple multi-hop question answering benchmarks show that \textsc{TaSR-RAG} consistently outperforms strong RAG and structured-RAG baselines by up to 14\%, while producing clearer evidence attribution and more faithful reasoning traces.

AI.title_translation: TaSR-RAG：面向检索增强生成的分类法引导的结构化推理
AI.tldr: TaSR-RAG通过将查询和文档表示为受分类法约束的关系三元组，并采用分步的混合三元组匹配策略来选择证据，解决了传统RAG推理脆弱和结构化RAG构建成本高的问题，在多跳问答中表现优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG系统通常检索非结构化块并依赖单次生成，导致上下文冗余、信息密度低和脆弱的多跳推理。虽然结构化RAG可以提高基础性，但它们通常需要昂贵且易出错的图构建，或者采用不与查询推理链对齐的僵化以实体为中心的结构。
AI.method: TaSR-RAG框架将查询和文档表示为关系三元组，并使用轻量级的两级分类法来约束实体语义。它将复杂问题分解为有序的三元组子查询序列，然后通过结合原始三元组的语义相似性和类型化三元组的结构一致性的混合三元组匹配来进行分步证据选择。该方法通过在步骤间维护一个显式的实体绑定表来解决中间变量并减少实体混淆，而无需明确的图构建或穷举搜索。
AI.result: TaSR-RAG在多个多跳问答基准测试中，一致地超越了强大的RAG和结构化RAG基线，提升高达14%，同时产生了更清晰的证据归属和更忠实的推理轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 在多个多跳问答基准测试中，TaSR-RAG一致地超越了强大的RAG和结构化RAG基线，提升高达14%，同时产生了更清晰的证据归属和更忠实的推理轨迹。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成（RAG）通过将生成过程以外部证据为条件，帮助大型语言模型（LLMs）回答知识密集型和时间敏感型问题。然而，大多数RAG系统仍然检索非结构化块并依赖单次生成，这通常会导致上下文冗余、信息密度低和脆弱的多跳推理。虽然结构化RAG管道可以提高基础性，但它们通常需要昂贵且容易出错的图构建，或者施加不与查询推理链对齐的僵化以实体为中心的结构。我们提出了\textsc{TaSR-RAG}，一个用于证据选择的分类法引导的结构化推理框架。我们将查询和文档都表示为关系三元组，并使用轻量级的两级分类法来约束实体语义，以平衡泛化性和精确性。给定一个复杂问题，\textsc{TaSR-RAG}将其分解为一个带有显式潜在变量的有序三元组子查询序列，然后通过结合原始三元组的语义相似性与类型化三元组的结构一致性的混合三元组匹配来进行分步证据选择。通过在步骤间维护一个显式的实体绑定表，\textsc{TaSR-RAG}无需显式图构建或穷举搜索即可解决中间变量并减少实体混淆。在多个多跳问答基准测试上的实验表明，\textsc{TaSR-RAG}一致地超越了强大的RAG和结构化RAG基线，提升高达14%，同时产生了更清晰的证据归属和更忠实的推理轨迹。
AI.summary: TaSR-RAG是一个分类法引导的结构化推理框架，用于改进检索增强生成（RAG）中的证据选择。它通过将查询和文档表示为关系三元组，并利用轻量级分类法约束实体语义，将复杂问题分解为有序的三元组子查询。系统通过混合三元组匹配进行分步证据选择，并通过维护实体绑定表来解决中间变量，从而提高了多跳推理的准确性和证据归属的清晰度。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 结构化推理, 证据选择, 分类法引导, 关系三元组
AI.comments: 该方法的主要创新在于使用轻量级的两级分类法来指导结构化推理和证据选择，从而避免了传统结构化RAG中昂贵且容易出错的图构建，同时解决了非结构化RAG中推理脆弱和信息密度低的问题。其核心在于将查询和文档表示为关系三元组，并通过混合三元组匹配进行分步证据选择。

title: Robust Regularized Policy Iteration under Transition Uncertainty
summary: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) enables data-efficient and safe policy learning without online exploration, but its performance often degrades under distribution shift. The learned policy may visit out-of-distribution state-action pairs where value estimates and learned dynamics are unreliable. To address policy-induced extrapolation and transition uncertainty in a unified framework, we formulate offline RL as robust policy optimization, treating the transition kernel as a decision variable within an uncertainty set and optimizing the policy against the worst-case dynamics. We propose Robust Regularized Policy Iteration (RRPI), which replaces the intractable max-min bilevel objective with a tractable KL-regularized surrogate and derives an efficient policy iteration procedure based on a robust regularized Bellman operator. We provide theoretical guarantees by showing that the proposed operator is a $γ$-contraction and that iteratively updating the surrogate yields monotonic improvement of the original robust objective with convergence. Experiments on D4RL benchmarks demonstrate that RRPI achieves strong average performance, outperforming recent baselines including percentile-based methods such as PMDB on the majority of environments while remaining competitive on the rest. Moreover, RRPI exhibits robust behavior. The learned $Q$-values decrease in regions with higher epistemic uncertainty, suggesting that the resulting policy avoids unreliable out-of-distribution actions under transition uncertainty.

AI.title_translation: 转换不确定性下的鲁棒正则化策略迭代
AI.tldr: 针对离线强化学习中因分布偏移和转换不确定性导致的性能下降，本文提出了鲁棒正则化策略迭代（RRPI），通过鲁棒策略优化和KL-正则化替代，实现了强大的性能和鲁棒性，有效避免了不可靠的超出分布动作。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习（RL）在分布偏移下性能常常下降，导致学习到的策略在访问超出分布的状态-动作对时，价值估计和学习到的动态不可靠。
AI.method: 将离线RL公式化为鲁棒策略优化，将转换核视为不确定性集内的决策变量，并针对最差情况动态优化策略。提出鲁棒正则化策略迭代（RRPI），用可处理的KL-正则化替代物取代了难处理的最大-最小双层目标，并基于鲁棒正则化Bellman算子推导出高效的策略迭代过程。同时提供理论保证，证明所提出的算子是$γ$-收缩的。
AI.result: 在D4RL基准测试中，RRPI实现了强大的平均性能，在大多数环境中优于包括PMDB在内的最新基线方法，并在其余环境中保持竞争力。RRPI还表现出鲁棒行为，学习到的Q值在认知不确定性较高的区域降低，表明其策略在转换不确定性下避免了不可靠的超出分布动作。
AI.conclusion: RRPI通过在统一框架中解决策略引起的外推和转换不确定性问题，在离线强化学习中实现了强大的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 离线强化学习（RL）无需在线探索即可实现数据高效和安全的策略学习，但其性能在分布偏移下常常下降。学习到的策略可能会访问超出分布的状态-动作对，导致价值估计和学习到的动态不可靠。为了在统一框架中解决策略引起的外推和转换不确定性问题，我们将离线RL公式化为鲁棒策略优化，将转换核视为不确定性集内的决策变量，并针对最差情况动态优化策略。我们提出了鲁棒正则化策略迭代（RRPI），它用可处理的KL-正则化替代物取代了难处理的最大-最小双层目标，并基于鲁棒正则化Bellman算子推导出了高效的策略迭代过程。我们通过证明所提出的算子是$γ$-收缩的，并且迭代更新替代物能使原始鲁棒目标单调改进并收敛，从而提供了理论保证。D4RL基准测试的实验表明，RRPI实现了强大的平均性能，在大多数环境中优于包括PMDB在内的最新基线方法，并在其余环境中保持竞争力。此外，RRPI表现出鲁棒行为。学习到的Q值在认知不确定性较高的区域降低，这表明由此产生的策略在转换不确定性下避免了不可靠的超出分布动作。
AI.summary: 本文针对离线强化学习中因分布偏移导致的外推问题和转换不确定性，提出了鲁棒正则化策略迭代（RRPI）。RRPI将离线RL建模为鲁棒策略优化，通过将转换核视为不确定性集内的决策变量，并优化对抗最差情况动态的策略。该方法引入KL-正则化替代目标和鲁棒正则化Bellman算子进行高效迭代，并提供理论收敛性保证。实验结果表明，RRPI在D4RL基准测试上表现出优越的性能和鲁棒性，有效避免了不可靠的超出分布动作。
AI.keywords: 离线强化学习, 鲁棒策略优化, 转换不确定性, 分布偏移, 策略迭代
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过将离线RL中的分布偏移和转换不确定性问题统一到鲁棒策略优化框架中，提供了一种新颖的解决方案。其创新点在于引入KL-正则化替代目标和鲁棒正则化Bellman算子，使得原本难以处理的鲁棒优化问题变得可解且高效。理论保证和在D4RL上的优异表现进一步验证了该方法的有效性和重要性，尤其是在提高离线RL的可靠性和安全性方面。

title: The Virtuous Cycle: AI-Powered Vector Search and Vector Search-Augmented AI
summary: Modern AI and vector search are rapidly converging, forming a promising research frontier in intelligent information systems. On one hand, advances in AI have substantially improved the semantic accuracy and efficiency of vector search, including learned indexing structures, adaptive pruning strategies, and automated parameter tuning. On the other hand, powerful vector search techniques have enabled new AI paradigms, notably Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which effectively mitigates challenges in Large Language Models (LLMs) like knowledge staleness and hallucinations. This mutual reinforcement establishes a virtuous cycle where AI injects intelligence and adaptive optimization into vector search, while vector search, in turn, expands AI's capabilities in knowledge integration and context-aware generation. This tutorial provides a comprehensive overview of recent research and advancements at this intersection. We begin by discussing the foundational background and motivations for integrating vector search and AI. Subsequently, we explore how AI empowers vector search (AI4VS) across each step of the vector search pipeline. We then investigate how vector search empowers AI (VS4AI), with a particular focus on RAG frameworks that integrate dynamic, external knowledge sources into the generative process of LLMs. Furthermore, we analyze end-to-end co-optimization strategies that fully unlock the potential of the ``virtuous cycle" between vector search and AI. Finally, we highlight key challenges and future research opportunities in this emerging area. This paper was published in ICDE 2026.

AI.title_translation: 良性循环：AI驱动的向量搜索与向量搜索增强的AI
AI.tldr: AI和向量搜索相互促进，形成一个良性循环，增强了智能信息系统。
AI.motivation: 现代AI和向量搜索正在快速融合，形成智能信息系统中有前景的研究前沿，它们之间存在相互强化的关系。
AI.method: 本教程全面概述了这一交叉领域的研究进展，讨论了集成背景和动机，探讨了AI如何赋能向量搜索（AI4VS），向量搜索如何赋能AI（VS4AI），特别是RAG框架，分析了端到端协同优化策略，并指出了挑战和未来研究机会。
AI.result: 论文描述了AI如何通过学习索引结构、自适应剪枝策略和自动化参数调优等方式提升向量搜索的语义准确性和效率；同时，向量搜索如何通过RAG等技术缓解大型语言模型（LLMs）的知识陈旧和幻觉等问题，从而扩展AI的能力。这种相互强化建立了AI和向量搜索之间的“良性循环”。
AI.conclusion: AI和向量搜索之间的相互强化建立了一个良性循环，AI为向量搜索注入智能和自适应优化，而向量搜索则扩展了AI在知识集成和上下文感知生成方面的能力，该领域仍存在关键挑战和未来研究机会。
AI.translation: 现代AI和向量搜索正在迅速融合，形成了智能信息系统中有前景的研究前沿。一方面，AI的进步显著提升了向量搜索的语义准确性和效率，包括学习索引结构、自适应剪枝策略和自动化参数调优。另一方面，强大的向量搜索技术催生了新的AI范式，特别是检索增强生成（RAG），它有效缓解了大型语言模型（LLMs）中知识陈旧和幻觉等挑战。这种相互强化建立了一个良性循环，其中AI为向量搜索注入智能和自适应优化，而向量搜索反过来扩展了AI在知识集成和上下文感知生成方面的能力。本教程全面概述了这一交叉领域的最新研究和进展。我们首先讨论了集成向量搜索和AI的基础背景和动机。随后，我们探讨了AI如何在向量搜索管道的每一步赋能向量搜索（AI4VS）。接着，我们研究了向量搜索如何赋能AI（VS4AI），特别关注了将动态外部知识源集成到LLM生成过程中的RAG框架。此外，我们分析了端到端协同优化策略，以充分释放向量搜索和AI之间“良性循环”的潜力。最后，我们强调了这一新兴领域的关键挑战和未来的研究机会。本文发表于ICDE 2026。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了AI和向量搜索如何相互促进，形成一个良性循环。AI通过改进索引、剪枝和参数调优提升向量搜索的准确性和效率；反之，向量搜索通过检索增强生成（RAG）等技术，解决了大型语言模型（LLMs）的知识陈旧和幻觉问题，增强了AI的能力。本教程全面概述了这一交叉领域，涵盖了AI4VS、VS4AI（特别是RAG）、协同优化策略、挑战和未来研究机会。
AI.keywords: AI, 向量搜索, 检索增强生成 (RAG), 大型语言模型 (LLMs), 良性循环
AI.comments: 这篇论文揭示了AI和向量搜索之间强大的共生关系，提出了“良性循环”的概念，强调了两者在构建更智能、更高效的信息系统中的关键作用。特别是对检索增强生成（RAG）的关注，突出了向量搜索在解决LLM局限性方面的创新潜力，为未来研究提供了清晰的路线图。

title: Robust Provably Secure Image Steganography via Latent Iterative Optimization
comments: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026)
summary: We propose a robust and provably secure image steganography framework based on latent-space iterative optimization. Within this framework, the receiver treats the transmitted image as a fixed reference and iteratively refines a latent variable to minimize the reconstruction error, thereby improving message extraction accuracy. Unlike prior methods, our approach preserves the provable security of the embedding while markedly enhancing robustness under various compression and image processing scenarios. On benchmark datasets, the experimental results demonstrate that the proposed iterative optimization not only improves robustness against image compression while preserving provable security, but can also be applied as an independent module to further reinforce robustness in other provably secure steganographic schemes. This highlights the practicality and promise of latent-space optimization for building reliable, robust, and secure steganographic systems.
comment: This paper has been accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026)

AI.title_translation: 鲁棒可证明安全图像隐写术通过潜在迭代优化
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于潜在空间迭代优化的鲁棒且可证明安全的图像隐写框架，显著提高消息提取精度和对图像处理的鲁棒性，同时保持可证明安全性。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像隐写方法在保持可证明安全性的同时，在各种压缩和图像处理场景下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出一个基于潜在空间迭代优化的鲁棒且可证明安全的图像隐写框架。接收方将传输图像视为固定参考，迭代优化潜在变量以最小化重建误差，从而提高消息提取精度。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的迭代优化不仅在保持可证明安全性的同时提高了对图像压缩的鲁棒性，还可以作为一个独立模块应用于其他可证明安全的隐写方案中，进一步增强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间优化对于构建可靠、鲁棒和安全的隐写系统具有实用性和前景。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种基于潜在空间迭代优化的鲁棒且可证明安全的图像隐写框架。在该框架中，接收方将传输图像视为固定参考，并迭代优化一个潜在变量以最小化重建误差，从而提高消息提取精度。与以前的方法不同，我们的方法在保持嵌入的可证明安全性的同时，显著增强了在各种压缩和图像处理场景下的鲁棒性。在基准数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的迭代优化不仅在保持可证明安全性的同时提高了对图像压缩的鲁棒性，而且还可以作为一个独立模块应用于其他可证明安全的隐写方案中，以进一步增强鲁棒性。这突出了潜在空间优化在构建可靠、鲁棒和安全的隐写系统方面的实用性和前景。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的图像隐写框架，利用潜在空间迭代优化技术，显著提升了消息提取的准确性和系统在图像压缩及处理下的鲁棒性，同时维持了可证明的安全性。该方法通过接收方迭代优化潜在变量来最小化重建误差，实验证明其不仅自身表现优异，还能作为独立模块增强现有安全隐写方案的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 图像隐写术, 鲁棒性, 可证明安全性, 潜在迭代优化, 图像处理
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将潜在空间迭代优化引入到图像隐写术中，解决了传统方法在鲁棒性和可证明安全性之间难以兼顾的问题。其提出的模块化方法也增加了其实用价值，为构建更可靠的隐写系统提供了新思路。

title: TA-GGAD: Testing-time Adaptive Graph Model for Generalist Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: A significant number of anomalous nodes in the real world, such as fake news, noncompliant users, malicious transactions, and malicious posts, severely compromises the health of the graph data ecosystem and urgently requires effective identification and processing. With anomalies that span multiple data domains yet exhibit vast differences in features, cross-domain detection models face severe domain shift issues, which limit their generalizability across all domains. This study identifies and quantitatively analyzes a specific feature mismatch pattern exhibited by domain shift in graph anomaly detection, which we define as the \emph{Anomaly Disassortativity} issue ($\mathcal{AD}$). Based on the modeling of the issue $\mathcal{AD}$, we introduce a novel graph foundation model for anomaly detection. It achieves cross-domain generalization in different graphs, requiring only a single training phase to perform effectively across diverse domains. The experimental findings, based on fourteen diverse real-world graphs, confirm a breakthrough in the model's cross-domain adaptation, achieving a pioneering state-of-the-art (SOTA) level in terms of detection accuracy. In summary, the proposed theory of $\mathcal{AD}$ provides a novel theoretical perspective and a practical route for future research in generalist graph anomaly detection (GGAD). The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Anonymization-TA-GGAD/.

AI.title_translation: TA-GGAD：用于通用图异常检测的测试时自适应图模型
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为TA-GGAD的新型图模型，用于解决跨领域图异常检测中的域迁移问题。该模型通过识别和量化“异常离异性”（Anomaly Disassortativity, AD）问题，实现了单次训练即可在不同图数据上有效检测异常，并在14个真实世界图数据集上取得了先进的（SOTA）检测精度。
AI.motivation: 跨领域图异常检测模型在面对不同数据域时存在严重的域迁移问题，限制了其通用性。需要一种能够有效识别和处理跨多个数据域但特征差异巨大的异常节点的方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“异常离异性”（Anomaly Disassortativity, AD）的特征不匹配模式，并基于此构建了一个新颖的图基础模型。该模型只需一次训练即可实现跨领域泛化。
AI.result: 在14个多样化的真实世界图数据集上进行了实验，结果证实了模型在跨领域自适应方面的突破，达到了开创性的（SOTA）检测精度水平。
AI.conclusion: 提出的AD理论为通用图异常检测（GGAD）提供了新颖的理论视角和实用的研究途径，并且该模型在实验中取得了显著的成果。
AI.translation: 现实世界中存在大量的异常节点，例如虚假新闻、违规用户、恶意交易和恶意帖子，严重损害了图数据生态系统的健康，迫切需要有效的识别和处理。跨领域检测模型在面对跨越多个数据域但特征差异巨大的异常时，会遇到严重的域迁移问题，这限制了它们在所有域上的泛化能力。本研究识别并定量分析了图异常检测中域迁移所表现出的特定特征不匹配模式，我们称之为“异常离异性”问题（$ oldsymbol{	ext{Anomaly Disassortativity}}$，$ oldsymbol{	ext{AD}}$）。基于对$ oldsymbol{	ext{AD}}$问题的建模，我们引入了一种新颖的用于异常检测的图基础模型。它实现了在不同图上的跨领域泛化，只需一次训练即可在不同域上有效运行。基于十四个多样化的真实世界图的实验结果，证实了该模型在跨领域自适应方面取得了突破，在检测精度方面达到了开创性的先进（SOTA）水平。总之，提出的AD理论为通用图异常检测（GGAD）的未来研究提供了新颖的理论视角和实用的途径。代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Anonymization-TA-GGAD/获取。
AI.summary: 该研究针对跨领域图异常检测中的域迁移问题，提出了一种名为TA-GGAD的新型图基础模型。通过识别并量化“异常离异性”（AD）这一关键的特征不匹配模式，TA-GGAD模型实现了单次训练即可在不同图数据上有效检测异常，并在多个真实世界数据集上取得了先进的检测精度，为通用图异常检测领域提供了新的理论和实践方向。
AI.keywords: 图异常检测, 跨领域泛化, 域迁移, 异常离异性, 图基础模型
AI.comments: 该研究提出的“异常离异性”（AD）概念为理解和解决图异常检测中的域迁移问题提供了一个新颖且有价值的视角。模型仅需一次训练即可实现跨领域泛化的能力，极大地提高了其实用性和效率。然而，抽象中并未详细说明AD的具体量化方式以及模型如何精确地利用AD信息进行自适应调整，这是未来研究可以深入探讨的方向。此外，虽然在14个数据集上取得了SOTA结果，但模型的计算复杂度和在大规模图上的实际部署表现也值得进一步关注。

title: Interactive 3D visualization of surface roughness predictions in additive manufacturing: A data-driven framework
summary: Surface roughness in Material Extrusion Additive Manufacturing varies across a part and is difficult to anticipate during process planning because it depends on both printing parameters and local surface inclination, which governs the staircase effect. A data-driven framework is presented to predict the arithmetic mean roughness (Ra) prior to fabrication using process parameters and surface angle. A structured experimental dataset was created using a three-level Box-Behnken design: 87 specimens were printed, each with multiple planar faces spanning different inclination angles, yielding 1566 Ra measurements acquired with a contact profilometer. A multilayer perceptron regressor was trained to capture nonlinear relationships between manufacturing conditions, inclination, and Ra. To mitigate limited experimental data, a conditional generative adversarial network was used to generate additional condition-specific tabular samples, thereby improving predictive performance. Model performance was assessed on a hold-out test set. A web-based decision-support interface was also developed to enable interactive process planning by loading a 3D model, specifying printing parameters, and adjusting the part's orientation. The system computes face-wise inclination from the model geometry and visualizes predicted Ra as an interactive colormap over the surface, enabling rapid identification of regions prone to high roughness and immediate comparison of parameter and orientation choices.

AI.title_translation: 增材制造中表面粗糙度预测的交互式3D可视化：一个数据驱动的框架
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一个基于数据的系统，用于预测3D打印的表面粗糙度。他们训练了一个神经网络，并使用GANs来改进它，然后构建了一个网页工具，可以在3D模型上实时显示粗糙度预测，帮助工程师选择最佳的打印设置和零件方向。
AI.motivation: 材料挤出增材制造中的表面粗糙度在零件上是变化的，并且由于依赖于打印参数和局部表面倾角（影响阶梯效应），在工艺规划期间难以预测。需要一个工具来提前预测粗糙度以优化制造过程。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含打印参数、表面倾角和Ra测量的实验数据集（87个样本，1566个测量值）。使用多层感知器（MLP）回归器进行初始预测模型训练。为克服数据限制，引入条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）生成额外的条件特定样本以增强模型性能。最后，开发了一个基于Web的决策支持界面，用于3D模型加载、参数设置、方向调整，并以交互式颜色图的形式可视化预测的Ra值。
AI.result: 训练的MLP模型能够捕获制造条件、倾角和Ra之间的非线性关系。使用cGAN生成额外数据后，模型的预测性能得到提高。最终的系统能够加载3D模型，计算面部倾角，并将预测的Ra值以交互式颜色图的形式可视化在表面上，使用户能够快速识别高粗糙度区域并比较参数和方向选择。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功开发了一个数据驱动框架，能够预测增材制造中的表面粗糙度（Ra），并通过一个交互式的3D可视化决策支持界面，使用户能够直观地评估不同工艺参数和零件方向对粗糙度的影响，从而实现快速、优化的工艺规划。
AI.translation: 材料挤出增材制造中的表面粗糙度随零件变化，并且由于它依赖于打印参数和控制阶梯效应的局部表面倾角，因此在工艺规划期间难以预测。本文提出了一个数据驱动的框架，用于在使用工艺参数和表面角度之前预测算术平均粗糙度（Ra）。使用三级Box-Behnken设计创建了一个结构化的实验数据集：打印了87个样本，每个样本都有跨越不同倾角的多个平面，从而获得了1566个使用接触式轮廓仪采集的Ra测量值。训练了一个多层感知器回归器来捕捉制造条件、倾角和Ra之间的非线性关系。为减轻实验数据有限的问题，使用条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）生成了额外的特定于条件的表格样本，从而提高了预测性能。在保留的测试集上评估了模型的性能。还开发了一个基于Web的决策支持界面，通过加载3D模型、指定打印参数和调整零件方向，以实现交互式工艺规划。该系统从模型几何结构中计算面部倾角，并将预测的Ra作为交互式颜色图可视化在表面上，从而能够快速识别易产生高粗糙度的区域，并立即比较参数和方向的选择。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种数据驱动框架，用于在材料挤出增材制造前预测表面粗糙度（Ra）。该框架结合了多层感知器模型和条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）来增强预测的准确性。核心创新是一个交互式的Web界面，它将预测的Ra值以3D模型上的颜色图形式可视化，使用户能够直观地调整打印参数和零件方向，从而实现快速、优化的工艺规划。
AI.keywords: 表面粗糙度, 增材制造, 数据驱动, 交互式可视化, 工艺规划
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于结合了数据驱动的预测模型（MLP和cGAN）与交互式3D可视化决策支持系统，直接解决了增材制造中表面粗糙度预测和工艺规划的实际难题。其重要性在于提供了一种直观、快速的工具来优化制造过程，减少试错。局限性可能在于模型对训练数据的依赖性以及cGAN生成数据的质量。

title: Democratising Clinical AI through Dataset Condensation for Classical Clinical Models
summary: Dataset condensation (DC) learns a compact synthetic dataset that enables models to match the performance of full-data training, prioritising utility over distributional fidelity. While typically explored for computational efficiency, DC also holds promise for healthcare data democratisation, especially when paired with differential privacy, allowing synthetic data to serve as a safe alternative to real records. However, existing DC methods rely on differentiable neural networks, limiting their compatibility with widely used clinical models such as decision trees and Cox regression. We address this gap using a differentially private, zero-order optimisation framework that extends DC to non-differentiable models using only function evaluations. Empirical results across six datasets, including both classification and survival tasks, show that the proposed method produces condensed datasets that preserve model utility while providing effective differential privacy guarantees - enabling model-agnostic data sharing for clinical prediction tasks without exposing sensitive patient information.

AI.title_translation: 通过对经典临床模型进行数据集浓缩，实现临床AI的民主化
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种新的、基于零阶优化的数据集浓缩技术，可以为决策树和Cox回归等传统临床模型创建紧凑且受差分隐私保护的合成数据集，从而促进了临床AI的普及和安全数据共享。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集浓缩（DC）方法依赖于可微分神经网络，限制了它们与广泛使用的临床模型（如决策树和Cox回归）的兼容性。此外，DC在与差分隐私结合时，有潜力通过提供安全的合成数据替代真实记录来实现医疗数据的民主化。
AI.method: 使用一个差分隐私的、零阶优化框架，该框架仅使用函数评估即可将数据集浓缩扩展到非可微分模型（如决策树和Cox回归）。
AI.result: 在包括分类和生存任务的六个数据集上的实证结果表明，所提出的方法生成的浓缩数据集能够保持模型效用，同时提供有效的差分隐私保证。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法能够生成保留模型效用并提供有效差分隐私保证的浓缩数据集，从而在不暴露敏感患者信息的情况下，实现临床预测任务的模型无关数据共享。
AI.translation: 数据集浓缩（DC）学习一个紧凑的合成数据集，使模型能够匹配完整数据训练的性能，优先考虑效用而非分布保真度。虽然DC通常是为计算效率而探索的，但它在医疗数据民主化方面也显示出潜力，特别是与差分隐私结合时，允许合成数据作为真实记录的安全替代品。然而，现有的DC方法依赖于可微分神经网络，限制了它们与广泛使用的临床模型（如决策树和Cox回归）的兼容性。我们使用一个差分隐私的、零阶优化框架来解决这一差距，该框架仅使用函数评估即可将DC扩展到非可微分模型。跨越六个数据集（包括分类和生存任务）的实证结果表明，所提出的方法生成的浓缩数据集保留了模型效用，同时提供了有效的差分隐私保证——使临床预测任务无需暴露敏感患者信息即可实现模型无关的数据共享。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的方法，通过使用差分隐私的零阶优化框架，将数据集浓缩（DC）技术扩展到不支持梯度计算的临床模型（如决策树和Cox回归）。这解决了现有DC方法与经典临床模型不兼容的问题，使得能够生成紧凑、隐私保护的合成数据集，从而实现临床AI工具的模型无关数据共享和民主化。
AI.keywords: 数据集浓缩, 差分隐私, 临床AI, 非可微分模型, 零阶优化
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将数据集浓缩（DC）扩展到了非可微分的临床模型（如决策树和Cox回归），这通过零阶优化框架实现，解决了现有DC方法对可微分神经网络的依赖性。这对于临床AI的普及化和隐私保护至关重要。局限性在于其性能是否能完全媲美使用完整数据集训练的模型的真实世界泛化能力有待进一步验证。

title: ProvAgent: Threat Detection Based on Identity-Behavior Binding and Multi-Agent Collaborative Attack Investigation
comments: The code of ProvAgent is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/Win7ery/ProvAgent}
summary: Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) pose critical challenges to modern cybersecurity due to their multi-stage and stealthy nature. While provenance-based detection approaches show promise in capturing causal attack semantics, current threat provenance practices face two paradoxical issues: (1) expert skepticism, where human analysts doubt the capability of traditional detection models to identify complex attacks; and (2) expert dependence, as analysts cannot manually process large-scale raw logs to detect threats without these models. Consequently, collaboration between humans and traditional models remains the prevailing paradigm. However, this renders investigation quality contingent upon human expertise and frequently results in alert fatigue. To address these challenges, we present ProvAgent, a framework that evolves the threat provenance paradigm from human-model collaboration to a novel collaboration between multi-agent systems and traditional models. ProvAgent leverages the speed and cost-efficiency of traditional models for initial anomaly screening over large-scale logs. By enforcing fine-grained identity-behavior consistency via graph contrastive learning, it profiles entities based on specific attributes to generate high-fidelity alerts. With these alerts serving as investigation entry points, ProvAgent achieves in-depth autonomous investigation through a hypothesis-verification multi-agent framework. Evaluations with real-world datasets demonstrate that ProvAgent outperforms six state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines in anomaly detection. Through automated investigation, ProvAgent reconstructs near-complete attack processes at a minimum cost of \$0.06 per day.
comment: The code of ProvAgent is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/Win7ery/ProvAgent}

title: Evidential Perfusion Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Residual Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have shown promise in addressing the ill-posed deconvolution problem in computed tomography perfusion (CTP) imaging for acute ischemic stroke assessment. However, existing PINN-based approaches remain deterministic and do not quantify uncertainty associated with violations of physics constraints, limiting reliability assessment. We propose Evidential Perfusion Physics-Informed Neural Networks (EPPINN), a framework that integrates evidential deep learning with physics-informed modeling to enable uncertainty-aware perfusion parameter estimation. EPPINN models arterial input, tissue concentration, and perfusion parameters using coordinate-based networks, and places a Normal--Inverse--Gamma distribution over the physics residual to characterize voxel-wise aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in physics consistency without requiring Bayesian sampling or ensemble inference. The framework further incorporates physiologically constrained parameterization and stabilization strategies to promote robust per-case optimization. We evaluate EPPINN on digital phantom data, the ISLES 2018 benchmark, and a clinical cohort. On the evaluated datasets, EPPINN achieves lower normalized mean absolute error than classical deconvolution and PINN baselines, particularly under sparse temporal sampling and low signal-to-noise conditions, while providing conservative uncertainty estimates with high empirical coverage. On clinical data, EPPINN attains the highest voxel-level and case-level infarct-core detection sensitivity. These results suggest that evidential physics-informed learning can improve both accuracy and reliability of CTP analysis for time-critical stroke assessment.

title: M3GCLR: Multi-View Mini-Max Infinite Skeleton-Data Game Contrastive Learning For Skeleton-Based Action Recognition
summary: In recent years, contrastive learning has drawn significant attention as an effective approach to reducing reliance on labeled data. However, existing methods for self-supervised skeleton-based action recognition still face three major limitations: insufficient modeling of view discrepancies, lack of effective adversarial mechanisms, and uncontrollable augmentation perturbations. To tackle these issues, we propose the Multi-view Mini-Max infinite skeleton-data Game Contrastive Learning for skeleton-based action Recognition (M3GCLR), a game-theoretic contrastive framework. First, we establish the Infinite Skeleton-data Game (ISG) model and the ISG equilibrium theorem, and further provide a rigorous proof, enabling mini-max optimization based on multi-view mutual information. Then, we generate normal-extreme data pairs through multi-view rotation augmentation and adopt temporally averaged input as a neutral anchor to achieve structural alignment, thereby explicitly characterizing perturbation strength. Next, leveraging the proposed equilibrium theorem, we construct a strongly adversarial mini-max skeleton-data game to encourage the model to mine richer action-discriminative information. Finally, we introduce the dual-loss equilibrium optimizer to optimize the game equilibrium, allowing the learning process to maximize action-relevant information while minimizing encoding redundancy, and we prove the equivalence between the proposed optimizer and the ISG model. Extensive Experiments show that M3GCLR achieves three-stream 82.1%, 85.8% accuracy on NTU RGB+D 60 (X-Sub, X-View) and 72.3%, 75.0% accuracy on NTU RGB+D 120 (X-Sub, X-Set). On PKU-MMD Part I and II, it attains 89.1%, 45.2% in three-stream respectively, all results matching or outperforming state-of-the-art performance. Ablation studies confirm the effectiveness of each component.

title: From Representation to Clusters: A Contrastive Learning Approach for Attributed Hypergraph Clustering
comments: Accepted at The Web Conference 2026. 12 pages, 5 figures
summary: Contrastive learning has demonstrated strong performance in attributed hypergraph clustering. Typically, existing methods based on contrastive learning first learn node embeddings and then apply clustering algorithms, such as k-means, to these embeddings to obtain the clustering results.However, these methods lack direct clustering supervision, risking the inclusion of clustering-irrelevant information in the learned graph.To this end, we propose a Contrastive learning approach for Attributed Hypergraph Clustering (CAHC), an end-to-end method that simultaneously learns node embeddings and obtains clustering results. CAHC consists of two main steps: representation learning and cluster assignment learning. The former employs a novel contrastive learning approach that incorporates both node-level and hyperedge-level objectives to generate node embeddings.The latter joint embedding and clustering optimization to refine these embeddings by clustering-oriented guidance and obtains clustering results simultaneously.Extensive experimental results demonstrate that CAHC outperforms baselines on eight datasets.
comment: Accepted at The Web Conference 2026. 12 pages, 5 figures

title: Quantifying and extending the coverage of spatial categorization data sets
summary: Variation in spatial categorization across languages is often studied by eliciting human labels for the relations depicted in a set of scenes known as the Topological Relations Picture Series (TRPS). We demonstrate that labels generated by large language models (LLMs) align relatively well with human labels, and show how LLM-generated labels can help to decide which scenes and languages to add to existing spatial data sets. To illustrate our approach we extend the TRPS by adding 42 new scenes, and show that this extension achieves better coverage of the space of possible scenes than two previous extensions of the TRPS. Our results provide a foundation for scaling towards spatial data sets with dozens of languages and hundreds of scenes.

title: MIL-PF: Multiple Instance Learning on Precomputed Features for Mammography Classification
comments: 10 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code will be released
summary: Modern foundation models provide highly expressive visual representations, yet adapting them to high-resolution medical imaging remains challenging due to limited annotations and weak supervision. Mammography, in particular, is characterized by large images, variable multi-view studies and predominantly breast-level labels, making end-to-end fine-tuning computationally expensive and often impractical. We propose Multiple Instance Learning on Precomputed Features (MIL-PF), a scalable framework that combines frozen foundation encoders with a lightweight MIL head for mammography classification. By precomputing the semantic representations and training only a small task-specific aggregation module (40k parameters), the method enables efficient experimentation and adaptation without retraining large backbones. The architecture explicitly models the global tissue context and the sparse local lesion signals through attention-based aggregation. MIL-PF achieves state-of-the-art classification performance at clinical scale while substantially reducing training complexity. We release the code for full reproducibility.
